name: Nuova Copertura (Node.js)
author: nuovacopertura
description: Landing Nuova Copertura con form contatti (Express + static). Usa SERVER_PORT di Pelican e variabili SMTP nel pannello.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [ -f /home/container/package.json ]; then /usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev; fi; /usr/local/bin/node /home/container/server.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nuova Copertura — install (server files: /mnt/server)
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip libtool

echo -e "updating npm..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
  echo -e "USER_UPLOAD: skipping git clone."
  exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
  echo -e "using anon git clone"
else
  GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  echo -e "/mnt/server is not empty."
  if [ -d .git ] && [ -f .git/config ]; then
    ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
      git pull
    fi
  else
    echo -e "directory not empty and not a matching git repo — aborting to avoid data loss"
    exit 10
  fi
else
  if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
    git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  else
    git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
  /usr/local/bin/npm install --omit=dev
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Repository GitHub (es. https://github.com/tuo-user/nuovacopertura). Lasciare vuoto se carichi i file manualmente (USER_UPLOAD=1).

variables.name: Install Branch
variables.description: Branch da clonare (vuoto = default del repo).

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: 1 = salta clone git in install (upload SFTP). 0 = clone da GIT_ADDRESS.

variables.name: Contact destination email
variables.description: Indirizzo che riceve le richieste dal form (CONTACT_TO).

variables.name: SMTP From name
variables.description: Nome visualizzato del mittente (se SMTP_FROM è vuoto).

variables.name: SMTP From
variables.description: Mittente completo (es. "Preventivo <info@yrb4g.com>"). Lascia vuoto per usare SMTP_FROM_NAME + SMTP_USER.
